1 · Intro

When to use it.

When someone holds more than one job, a termination reaches further than the job you manage. Terminate Employment ends the work relationship and every assignment in it, including jobs in other areas.

Check every job and talk to the other HCM before you submit.

Use this whenSomeone you need to offboard holds more than one assignment, possibly in another school or department.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

None named yet.

To confirmNo document is named yet, and who submits when the jobs sit in different business units is an open item.

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • Every active assignment is listed and the primary one is found.
  • Leaving all jobs is Terminate Employment. Leaving only yours is End Assignment.
  • The HCM who owns the other assignment knows.
  • Primary is changed first if your job is primary and they keep another.

Cutoff

Submit before the payroll cutoff so pay stops on time. The exempt cutoff is around the 18th; check the payroll calendar.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You, with the other assignment's HCM.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Terminate Employment stops pay for every job. End Assignment stops only yours.

Watch-outs

  • Terminate Employment on a person who keeps another job stops pay for that job too.
  • Move any direct reports on the ending assignment to a new manager before it ends.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's rule for who submits when the jobs sit in different business units.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

How to handle a termination when an employee has multiple assignments

Use when: Someone you need to offboard holds more than one assignment, possibly in another school or department. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. List every active assignment and find the primary one.
  2. Ask: is the person leaving all jobs or only yours?
    • Keeps a job: End Assignment on yours
    • Leaves all: Terminate Employment
  3. Coordinate with the HCM who owns the other assignment.
  4. If your job is primary and they keep another, change primary first.
  5. Submit End Assignment or Terminate Employment with the right dates.
  6. Confirm the result in Employment Info.

Before you submit

  • Attach: None named yet. To confirm: No document is named yet, and who submits when the jobs sit in different business units is an open item.
  • Check: Every active assignment is listed and the primary one is found. Leaving all jobs is Terminate Employment. Leaving only yours is End Assignment. The HCM who owns the other assignment knows. Primary is changed first if your job is primary and they keep another.
  • Cutoff: Submitted before the payroll cutoff, so pay stops on time.

Watch-outs

  • Terminate Employment on a person who keeps another job stops pay for that job too.
  • Move any direct reports on the ending assignment to a new manager before it ends.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's rule for who submits when the jobs sit in different business units.
